findings.title: Blank-input rejection is untested

test.quote: test('save accepts', () => { const calls=[]; assert.deepEqual(save(' x ',{write:v=>calls.push(v)}),{tag:'Saved'}); assert.deepEqual(calls,['x']); });

support.quote: Blank input returns Invalid and never calls write.

findings.failure: An implementation that writes an empty string and returns Saved for blank input would pass the complete supplied suite.
findings.correction: Add a public save test with whitespace-only input that expects Invalid and verifies that write was never called.

findings.title: Pending polling interval has no independent oracle

support.quote: Pending and retrying poll at 5000ms unless writing.

findings.failure: Returning false or an incorrect interval consistently for pending while not writing passes this comparison and all surrounding tests.
findings.correction: Assert that poll('pending', false) equals the contractual value 5000 directly.
